name: beere-kesava
description: Repo-root tooling only. The application lives in backend/ and frontend/, each with its own package.json and lockfile; this file exists so git hooks have a single home rather than being duplicated per workspace.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.verify:backend: cd backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.verify:frontend: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
